name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Vegetable Fried Rice, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Cook rice in water until tender and cool it.
Dice vegetables. Heat oil and fry onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add carrot and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Fold in rice and soy sauce; heat through.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Chicken Fried Rice, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Cook rice and set aside.
Cut chicken into small pieces. Fry in oil until cooked through.
Add chopped onion and carrot; fry for 5 minutes. Stir in rice and soy sauce until steaming.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Egg Fried Rice, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Cook rice until tender and drain.
Fry diced onion and carrot in oil for 5 minutes.
Push vegetables aside, scramble eggs until set, then stir in rice and soy sauce.

name: Dhal Curry
description: Dhal Curry, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Rinse lentils and place in a saucepan with sliced onion, turmeric and curry leaves.
Cover with water and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Add coconut milk and salt; simmer gently for 8 minutes.

name: Potato Curry
description: Potato Curry, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Slice onion.
Cover potatoes and onion with water; simmer until almost tender.
Add coconut milk, curry powder and salt; simmer 10 minutes until thick.

name: Coconut Roti
description: Coconut Roti, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Mix flour, grated coconut and salt.
Add water gradually to form a soft dough. Rest 10 minutes.
Divide into 8 balls, flatten and cook on a hot dry pan for 3 minutes per side.

name: Egg Hoppers
description: Egg Hoppers, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, coconut milk and enough water for a pouring batter. Cover for 2–3 hours.
Stir in salt. Swirl a ladleful around a hot lightly oiled hopper pan.
Crack an egg into the centre; cover and cook until the white and yolk are set.

name: Vegetable Kottu
description: Vegetable Kottu, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Mix flour, water and salt into dough; roll thinly and cook in a pan. Slice into strips.
Fry sliced onion, carrot and cabbage in oil until tender.
Add curry powder and roti strips; chop and toss on the pan for 5 minutes.

name: Fish Curry
description: Fish Curry, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Cut fish into chunks and season with turmeric and salt.
Simmer chopped onion, tomato and curry powder in coconut milk for 8 minutes.
Add fish and simmer gently until opaque and cooked through.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Chicken Curry, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Fry chopped onion, garlic and ginger in oil.
Add curry powder and chicken pieces; brown for 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and salt. Cover and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.

name: Pol Sambol
description: Pol Sambol, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Finely chop onion and mix with chilli powder and salt.
Rub in freshly grated coconut until evenly coloured.
Squeeze over lime juice, mix and serve fresh.

name: Vegetable Pasta
description: Vegetable Pasta, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Boil pasta in water until tender and drain.
Fry chopped garlic and capsicum in oil. Add diced tomato and salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Toss pasta through the sauce and serve hot.

name: Chicken Pasta
description: Chicken Pasta, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Boil pasta and drain.
Fry diced chicken and garlic in oil until chicken is fully cooked.
Add cream and pepper; simmer 3 minutes. Fold in pasta.

name: Vegetable Omelette
description: Vegetable Omelette, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and finely diced vegetables.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan and pour in mixture.
Cook gently until the base sets; fold and cook until egg is set throughout.

name: Pancakes
description: Pancakes, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder together.
Beat in egg and milk until just combined.
Melt a little butter in a pan. Cook small ladles of batter until bubbles appear; flip and brown.

name: French Toast
description: French Toast, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Dip bread briefly on both sides.
Fry in butter for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and egg is cooked.

name: Potato Wedges
description: Potato Wedges, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Heat oven to 210°C. Scrub potatoes and cut into wedges.
Toss with oil, chilli powder and salt; spread on a tray.
Bake 30–35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.

name: Banana Smoothie
description: Banana Smoothie, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and slice bananas.
Blend with milk, yogurt and honey until smooth.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.

name: Fruit Salad
description: Fruit Salad, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Wash apple and dice. Peel and cut remaining fruit.
Combine fruit in a bowl and drizzle with honey.
Toss gently and chill until serving.

name: Tomato Soup
description: Tomato Soup, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Fry chopped onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and 1 cup water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Cool slightly, blend carefully and reheat before serving.

name: Vegetable Sandwich
description: Vegetable Sandwich, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Wash and thinly slice tomato and cucumber.
Butter bread and layer vegetables and cheese.
Close sandwiches and cut into triangles.

name: Milk Rice
description: Milk Rice, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Wash rice and cook with 3 cups water until soft.
Stir in coconut milk and salt; cook gently until absorbed.
Press onto a plate, cool for 5 minutes and cut into diamonds.

name: Pumpkin Curry
description: Pumpkin Curry, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel pumpkin and cut into cubes.
Place all ingredients in a pot with half a cup water.
Simmer covered until pumpkin is tender; uncover to thicken.

name: Chickpea Salad
description: Chickpea Salad, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Use cooked and cooled chickpeas; drain well.
Dice tomato and cucumber and chop coriander.
Toss with chickpeas, lime juice and salt.

name: Spinach Dhal
description: Spinach Dhal, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Rinse lentils; simmer with chopped onion, turmeric and 2 cups water for 20 minutes.
Wash and chop spinach.
Stir spinach, coconut milk and salt into lentils and simmer 5 minutes.

name: Garlic Butter Noodles
description: Garlic Butter Noodles, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Boil noodles according to packet instructions; drain.
Gently fry minced garlic in butter for 1 minute.
Toss noodles with garlic butter and soy sauce until hot.

name: Tuna Rice Bowl
description: Tuna Rice Bowl, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Cook rice until tender.
Drain canned tuna, slice cucumber and grate carrot.
Arrange tuna and vegetables over rice and drizzle with soy sauce.

name: Prawn Stir Fry
description: Prawn Stir Fry, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and devein prawns; slice capsicum.
Heat oil and fry garlic and ginger briefly. Add capsicum and cook 3 minutes.
Add prawns and soy sauce; stir-fry until prawns are opaque throughout.

name: Beef Pepper Skillet
description: Beef Pepper Skillet, a satisfying homemade dinner recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Slice beef thinly across the grain.
Sear beef in hot oil until cooked; transfer to a plate.
Fry onion and capsicum until tender. Return beef, add pepper and soy sauce and heat through.

name: Cabbage Mallung
description: Cabbage Mallung, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Finely shred washed cabbage.
Place in a pan with turmeric, curry leaves, salt and 2 tablespoons water.
Cover for 4 minutes then stir in coconut and cook uncovered for 5 minutes.

name: Beetroot Curry
description: Beetroot Curry, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel beetroot and slice into thin matchsticks.
Simmer with sliced onion, curry powder, salt and half a cup water for 15 minutes.
Add coconut milk and simmer until tender.

name: Green Bean Curry
description: Green Bean Curry, a satisfying homemade lunch recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Trim beans and cut into short lengths.
Place beans, sliced onion, turmeric and salt in a saucepan.
Add coconut milk and simmer gently until beans are tender.

name: Mushroom Toast
description: Mushroom Toast, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Slice mushrooms and mince garlic.
Fry in butter until mushrooms release liquid and brown; season with pepper.
Toast bread and spoon mushrooms over it.

name: Banana Oat Porridge
description: Banana Oat Porridge, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Simmer oats and milk on low heat, stirring frequently.
Mash half the banana into the porridge and cook until creamy.
Top with remaining banana slices and cinnamon.

name: Cheese Scrambled Eggs
description: Cheese Scrambled Eggs, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Whisk eggs and milk.
Melt butter over low heat and add eggs. Stir gently into soft curds.
Add grated cheese and continue cooking until egg is set.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Avocado Toast, a satisfying homemade breakfast recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Toast bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lime juice, salt and pepper.
Spread over toast and serve immediately.

name: Spiced Chickpeas
description: Spiced Chickpeas, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Drain cooked chickpeas and pat dry.
Heat oil in a pan and add chickpeas.
Stir in spices and salt; cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring regularly.

name: Cucumber Yogurt Dip
description: Cucumber Yogurt Dip, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Mix with yogurt and finely grated garlic.
Stir in chopped mint and salt; chill before serving.

name: Cheese Potato Cakes
description: Cheese Potato Cakes, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Boil peeled potatoes until tender; drain and mash.
Mix with cheese, flour and salt; shape into small patties.
Pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides and hot throughout.

name: Peanut Trail Mix
description: Peanut Trail Mix, a satisfying homemade snacks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Dry-toast peanuts and oats over low heat for 6 minutes.
Add honey and cinnamon, stirring to coat.
Spread on a plate and cool completely before breaking apart.

name: Coconut Semolina Pudding
description: Coconut Semolina Pudding, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Bring coconut milk to a gentle simmer.
Sprinkle in semolina while whisking to prevent lumps.
Stir in sugar and cardamom; cook until thick and spoon into bowls.

name: Chocolate Oat Cups
description: Chocolate Oat Cups, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Combine milk, cocoa and honey in a pan and warm gently.
Stir in oats and cook 5 minutes until thick.
Divide into small cups and refrigerate for 1 hour.

name: Cinnamon Baked Apples
description: Cinnamon Baked Apples, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Heat oven to 180°C. Core and halve apples.
Place in a baking dish; dot with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Add 2 tablespoons water and bake until soft.

name: Mango Yogurt Pots
description: Mango Yogurt Pots, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and dice mango; mash half into a puree.
Mix yogurt with honey.
Layer puree, yogurt and mango pieces in glasses and chill.

name: Caramel Banana
description: Caramel Banana, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel bananas and cut lengthwise.
Melt butter and sugar over medium-low heat until bubbling.
Add bananas and cinnamon; cook 2 minutes per side until golden.

name: Pineapple Coconut Cups
description: Pineapple Coconut Cups, a satisfying homemade desserts recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Dice peeled pineapple into small pieces.
Mix yogurt with honey and grated coconut.
Layer with pineapple and refrigerate until chilled.

name: Mango Lassi
description: Mango Lassi, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and dice mango.
Blend mango, yogurt, milk and sugar until smooth.
Divide between glasses and serve chilled.

name: Lime Mint Cooler
description: Lime Mint Cooler, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Squeeze lime juice into a jug.
Gently crush mint with sugar and add to the juice.
Stir in cold water until sugar dissolves and pour into glasses.

name: Spiced Milk Tea
description: Spiced Milk Tea, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Bring water and crushed cardamom to a boil.
Add tea and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add milk and sugar, heat gently and strain into cups.

name: Iced Cocoa
description: Iced Cocoa, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Mix cocoa and sugar with 3 tablespoons milk to make a paste.
Warm gently, stirring until smooth.
Whisk in remaining cold milk and chill before serving.

name: Papaya Smoothie
description: Papaya Smoothie, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Peel and deseed ripe papaya; cut into cubes.
Blend papaya with milk and yogurt until smooth.
Serve immediately in two glasses.

name: Ginger Coffee
description: Ginger Coffee, a satisfying homemade drinks recipe with simple ingredients and clear steps.
instructions: Simmer grated ginger in water for 3 minutes.
Stir in instant coffee and sugar.
Add warm milk, strain and serve.
